summary: Left 4 Dead entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

emulation.notes: Native PC route; no emulator required.

primary.why: Sami chose PC; Windows has the highest capture ceiling while Xbox 360 and Mac do not add sourced exclusive campaign content.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam/PC install at native monitor resolution; use Xbox 360 only for historical comparison.
